About the Developer

Bridging technical depth with community leadership.

Creating clean code architectures and unlocking the value inside complex data.

I am a 4th-year Computer Science Engineering student driven by curiosity for building software that solves tangible problems. My technical path is defined by a passion for backend systems, full-stack applications, and data engineering. Whether scaling Kubernetes nodes on AWS or transforming complex datasets into actionable business intelligence, I focus on performance, reliability, and clean engineering.

As the Task Force Lead at the Student Developers Community (SDC), I coordinate developer teams, run hackathons, and mentor juniors in agile development practices. I enjoy bridging the gap between rigorous logic and creative problem solving. When I'm not writing code or analyzing databases, I contribute to community welfare events as an NSS Volunteer, organizing outreach programs that impact real lives.
